about.heading: Built for Those Who Demand More
about.description: ForgeWell was founded in 2012 with a singular vision — to build Bhopal's most uncompromising fitness destination. We don't believe in shortcuts. Every square foot of our 15,000 sq.ft facility is engineered for results. From competition-grade lifting platforms to recovery suites, every detail serves your transformation.

services.heading: Training Programs Designed for Results
services.description: Every program is built on science, delivered with passion, and tailored to your body. No cookie-cutter plans — only precision coaching.

items.title: Personal Training
items.description: One-on-one sessions with certified trainers who build programs around your body, goals, and schedule.

items.title: Weight Training
items.description: Competition-grade platforms, Olympic bars, and a full free-weight floor for serious lifters.

items.title: Cardio Zone
items.description: State-of-the-art treadmills, bikes, rowers, and assault runners with integrated heart-rate tracking.

items.title: Group Classes
items.description: High-energy HIIT, spinning, yoga, and functional training classes led by specialist instructors.

items.title: Recovery Suite
items.description: Infrared sauna, cold plunge, foam rolling stations, and sports massage — recover like a pro.

items.title: Nutrition Coaching
items.description: Personalized meal plans, macro tracking guidance, and supplement advice from certified nutritionists.
